item.title: Following a Delivery Order
item.description: Follow a lamp you ordered as it moves from the seller to your home or a parcel locker. Read delivery updates, arrange another way to receive the lamp, and describe the condition of the package.

children.definition: To send goods from a shop or warehouse so they can reach the person who bought them.
children.example: The seller will dispatch my lamp on Monday, so it won't reach me this weekend.
collocations: dispatch an item from the warehouse

children.definition: A code that identifies a particular shipment. Some couriers let you use it to track the shipment.
children.example: I entered the shipment ID on the courier's website to see how far my lamp had travelled.

children.definition: On the way from the sender to the place where the goods will be delivered or picked up.
children.example: My lamp is still in transit between two warehouses, so I don't expect it today.

children.definition: The courier's best guess about the date or time when your goods will reach you.
children.example: The delivery estimate for my lamp says Thursday, so I'll plan to be home that day.

children.definition: With the courier for the final delivery run.
children.example: The lamp is out for delivery, so I'll keep my phone nearby in case the courier calls.
children.translation_uz: kuryer joʻnatmani manzilga olib borish uchun yoʻlga chiqqan
collocations: mark a parcel as out for delivery

children.definition: An occasion when a courier tries to bring goods to the person or place they are meant for.
children.example: The first delivery attempt failed because the courier couldn't get into my building.

children.definition: Another visit by a courier to bring goods after an earlier visit was unsuccessful.
children.example: I arranged redelivery for Friday because I'll be working from home that day.

children.definition: To send goods to a different place from the one originally planned.
children.example: Since I was away all week, I asked the courier to redirect my lamp to a parcel locker near my office.
collocations: redirect a shipment to another location

children.definition: A machine with small locked spaces where a courier can leave goods for people to pick up.
children.example: I went to the parcel terminal after work and took the lamp from the compartment that opened.
children.translation_uz: joʻnatmalarni olib ketish uchun qulflanadigan boʻlmalari bor avtomat

children.definition: A short code made up of digits that you enter to open the locker compartment holding your parcel.
children.example: I typed the access PIN from the courier's text into the terminal to open the compartment holding my lamp.
collocations: receive the access PIN by text

children.definition: A record, such as a photo or signature, that shows goods reached the place or person they were meant for.
children.example: I asked for proof of delivery when the courier's website said my lamp had been delivered but I couldn't find it.
collocations: use a photo as proof of delivery

children.definition: A document that comes with goods and lists what the sender has included.
children.example: I checked the delivery note inside the package and saw that a spare bulb was included with the lamp.
collocations: include a delivery note with the goods

children.definition: A parcel whose packaging is damaged, for example because it is torn or crushed.
children.example: I took a photo of the damaged package because one corner was crushed and the cardboard was torn.

children.definition: Still whole, with no parts broken or missing.
children.example: The lamp was intact when I took it out, even though the outer packaging was torn.
